g.text: LLM calls differ from paper tool-bearing turns. Linked tool rounds count unique parent calls; missing parents give a lower bound.
Boxes: median/IQR, whiskers 1.5 IQR, outliers hidden. Final is not judged success. Later calls have survivor selection.
Output kinds classify entire responses, not isolated Cypher/reasoning tokens. Peak input is not measured KV residency.
